excerpt.zh:
我们或许应当考虑雇佣一名新的£scientist£科学官来指挥全新的£science_ship£科研船。虽然科研船可以在没有科学家的情况下继续探索，但是失去了科学家的指导，他们便无法探测到异常现象。

选择我们的新科研船，点击指派领袖。领袖页面会展开，显示为我们服务的所有科学家。在列表顶部点击招募按钮。

选择你想要的科学家，然后点击招募按钮。招募领袖会花费£unity£凝聚力，请务必储存足够。

招募完毕后，新的科学家便会在母星中等待安排。

texts.en:
We need a £scientist£ Scientist to command our new £science_ship£ Science Ship, as it cannot survey or research Anomalies without one.

Select our new Science Ship, and then click on the portrait in the fleet interface. The Select a Leader window will open, showing all Scientists currently employed by us and those available for hire. Select the candidate you want.

Recruiting a Leader costs £unity£ Unity, and you may need to wait until you have enough stored.

Once recruited, the Science Ship can begin to explore.
